label: A self-comprehending recipient sets a threshold for strict comparison at esse
paraphrase: On one actual recipient x, if x knows itself at a degree a reaching its knowability, both its own measured act and its knowability are equivalent to a in the preorder. If an actual s knows any y at b strictly above that very a, x has strictly lower represented degree of esse than s. A selected giver may instantiate s. The statement asserts no such knowing, no strict difference for all recipients and no primitive comparative.
